concept: Columns of cards that move by drag and by keyboard alike, every move said aloud, a held card lifting a little.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a kanban board that only moves cards by mouse drag with coloured column headers
default_to_avoid.kind: kanban board, task board, card board
default_to_avoid.why_not: drag only leaves out the keyboard and screen readers, and coloured headers bring hues; Pane moves by keys too

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Space picks a card up, arrow keys carry it, Space drops and Esc cancels, and each move is said aloud

derivation.consequence: hover lifts a control a little closer
derivation.form: a held card lifts a little closer with the lift shadow and a ring

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: columns are level-2 panes and cards are small lit panes on them

options: C a table with a status column
variants.reason: A moves by keyboard as well as pointer (P6). B leaves keys out. C loses the board.

root.why: the hint, the columns and the live line stack

hint.why: a line says how to move cards with the keyboard

columns.why: columns sit side by side and scroll sideways, and the row takes focus so the keyboard can scroll it

column.why: each column is a level-2 pane that holds its cards on the board

over.why: a column a card is dragged over takes the quiet surface

title.why: the column title is semibold at label size with its count

count.why: the count is secondary in tabular figures beside the column title

list.why: cards stack with a small gap and an empty column keeps a drop target

card.why: a card is a small lit pane lit from above with a 44px height

held.why: a held card lifts with the lift shadow and a ring

cardTitle.why: the card title is at body size and wraps

meta.why: card details are secondary at caption size under the card title

live.why: a hidden live line says every pick up, move and drop

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard

background-color.why: a column eases into its over surface as a dragged card arrives

box-shadow.why: the lift shadow eases in as a card is picked up

transform.why: a picked up card rises a short distance on the hover ease
